raw_text:
Sofia Novak
Data Engineer, Berlin
sofia.novak@example.com

Summary
Data engineer with 6 years of experience building batch and warehouse pipelines.

Skills
Python, Spark, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, SQL, AWS

Experience

Senior Data Engineer at Klar Insights (2022 to 2026)
Built daily Spark jobs processing 3 terabytes of clickstream data.
Orchestrated 120 production pipelines with Airflow.
Modeled the analytics warehouse in dbt on top of Snowflake.
Tuned long-running SQL transformations for the finance mart.
Ran the whole platform on AWS EMR and S3.

Data Engineer at Portoflow (2020 to 2022)
Wrote Python ETL services for logistics events.

Education
MS Data Engineering, TU Berlin, 2020
